name: Exp_RJTX_Matches_Smoothed_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the RJTX Matches Smoothed indicator in a duplex (dual-direction) configuration, generating buy and sell signals from smoothed momentum crossovers. It opens positions when the smoothed signal line crosses key thresholds or its opposite-direction counterpart, relying on indicator-derived entry and exit logic. The duplex approach allows simultaneous monitoring of both bullish and bearish momentum shifts for systematic trade execution.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RJTX Matches平滑指标的双向配置进行交易，通过平滑动量交叉产生买入和卖出信号。当平滑信号线穿越关键阈值或反向对应线时开仓，依赖指标驱动的入场和出场逻辑。双向方法允许同时监控看涨和看跌动量变化，实现系统性交易执行。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用RJTX Matches Smoothed指标的双向（Duplex）配置，核心策略是基于动量平滑信号的交叉来判断市场方向。入场条件为：当看涨方向的平滑信号线向上穿越看跌方向信号线或穿越零轴时做多，反之作空。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号的出现或指标值回落至阈值以下。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应手数机制。资金管理方面，EA依赖外部参数设置止损和止盈，但缺少账户权益比例的风控逻辑。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，通过平滑处理减少噪音干扰，但在剧烈行情中可能存在滞后风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a duplex configuration of the RJTX Matches Smoothed indicator, with the core strategy based on momentum smoothed signal crossovers to determine market direction. Entry conditions: go long when the bullish smoothed signal line crosses above the bearish signal line or the zero axis, and vice versa for short positions. Exit conditions rely on the appearance of reverse crossover signals or the indicator value falling back below threshold levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic position adjustment or ATR-based adaptive lot mechanisms. Money management depends on externally configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, but lacks equity-proportional risk control logic. The overall strategy falls under momentum following, using smoothing to reduce market noise, but may suffer from lag in volatile market conditions.

pros: 双向Duplex配置可同时捕捉多空动量信号，提高交易机会
平滑处理有效减少市场噪音和假信号干扰
基于指标的系统性入场逻辑，避免情绪化交易决策
pros_en: Duplex dual-direction configuration captures both bullish and bearish momentum signals, increasing trade opportunities
Smoothing effectively reduces market noise and false signal interference
Indicator-based systematic entry logic avoids emotional trading decisions
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
动量指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号
平滑处理带来的滞后性可能导致入场延迟，错过最佳价位
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Momentum indicators tend to produce frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets
Smoothing-induced lag may cause delayed entries, missing optimal price levels
improvements: 增加ATR自适应仓位管理，根据市场波动动态调整手数
添加趋势过滤器（如大周期MA），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive position sizing to dynamically adjust lots according to market volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定手数不根据账户权益调整，大资金时风险敞口不可控
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
动量策略在震荡市中可能连续止损导致资金回撤
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not adjust with account equity, making risk exposure uncontrolled for large accounts
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
Momentum strategy may incur consecutive stop losses in ranging markets leading to drawdown
